content.title: AS - Sports news App - App Store
content.text: Welcome to the AS app, where you'll find top-quality content brought to you by one of the world’s leading sports-news outlets. Enjoy access to a source of comprehensive news and information about your favourite sports and teams: latest developments, live feeds, results, tables, schedules, videos… with AS, you won’t miss a thing. Download our app quickly and easily, totally free of charge. Our team of top journalists will keep you up to date on what’s going on in a whole host of sports including football, motorsport, basketball, tennis, cycling and handball. Enjoy an experience adapted to your mobile or tablet, with exclusive content from all the major competitions in football (LaLiga Santander, LaLiga Smartbank, Copa del Rey, Champions League, Europa League, Premier League…), basketball (NBA, Liga Endesa, EuroLeague…), tennis (grand slams, Masters 1000 events, Davis Cup…), cycling (Vuelta a España, Tour de France, Giro d’Italia…) and a range of other sports. With our app, you’ll have: - Access to every edition of AS: Spain, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, USA, Argentina, Peru and English. - News, exclusives, features and breaking developments relating to every sport and major league. - Live feeds covering every sport and domestic/international competition. - Personalised notifications that keep you up to date at all times. - Videos of goals, top pieces of play, press conferences and noteworthy incidents. - Opinion pieces by our headline journalists. - A new, faster and more intuitive design. - Access to the other sites in the AS family: Tikitakas, Epik, Betech and Deporte y Vida. With the AS app, you’ll be able to follow everything that’s happening in the sporting world. You can also find us on social media: follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and TikTok. *New reels block on the home screen. *Fixes and improvements to video playback. *Markup improvements and internal optimizations for a smoother experience.
